preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must be non-empty.
The lengths of strings s and t must not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if each character of string s occurs in at least one subsequence that matches string t.
Output 'No' if there is at least one character in string s that does not occur in any subsequence matching string t.
